208. Vamel Federation does its job (2)
The Storm God, Peitel.
Jin recalled the day he had fought with him during his cadet years in the Blue Bird province.

'After Murakan beat Yulian, Peitel descended in response to the power contained in Sigmund's Gramm. If the residual consciousness of Gramm hadn't awakened and given power, I would have died there that day.'
-[Heh, it's funny. So arrogant, but now you're being manipulated by a bug while your power is sealed. How is it, bug? Do you like my brother's power?]
- You, who can't even descend without a bug, are really talkative. Can't a god be a little more dignified?
[Heh, you seem to think you're like the ancient royal tribe. I don't know how you got that sword... What? Is that... from the royal tribe?]
- I received this sword directly from the one who killed your brother. Have you heard of the name, Transcendent Vahn, my brother?
The conversation with Peitel, who had descended in the Blue Bird province.

At that time, Peitel confirmed Jin's core and was terrified at the mention of Vahn's name, causing a stir. Moreover, when Jin summoned Tess during the fight, Peitel showed fear again and revealed a pitiful state.
There was not a single good memory. The only memory was of a crazy god, without dignity or any sublime feeling.
"I'm not sure if that fearful and foolish god... could be of any help. And whether he would help us."

"I've heard the story of how Peitel begged for his life from Murakan during your cadet years. You must have left bad feelings. If he refuses to cooperate, then Murakan will beat him again. Wouldn't that work?"
Jin was momentarily speechless at Valeria's surprisingly simple thinking. It was not something Valeria would usually say.
"...When you put it that way, it feels like we really need even the slimmest possibility."

"Right. And as you know, it's very rare for a god to lend a weapon to a contractor. Among them, Peitel is even more special as he grants three different weapons to the contractor, depending on his satisfaction."
"Like Peitel weaponizing the power of the storm, it may be possible to convert the core into a power source?"
"Exactly. If that's possible, we can build at least one golden ship before your brothers return. After all, you do have the core that you brought back with the blueprints from Lafrarosa."
"I got the gist. I'll prepare to contact Peitel as soon as Kaltor wakes up."
Jin thought of Yulian, who was by Kaltor's side every day. Since becoming a colleague, he has made significant contributions at crucial moments, but his mood has always been somber because of Kaltor.
Like Kuzan and Veris, he too had opened his heart to his colleagues, but he strongly conveyed the feeling that his life would be meaningless if Kaltor could not awaken.
"When Kaltor wakes up, we'll get to see that gloomy man smile."
"You barely smiled yourself until recently, Valeria."
"That's why I'm saying it's better this way. Anyway, this is the progress we've made so far. Everything else is fine, but there's no special progress on matters related to Lafrarosa."

"Don't get impatient if things aren't going well. All your colleagues know how hard you and Dr. Quol are working. And even if it's not the golden fleet, the shipyard is about to be completed, and ship production will start soon."

"Bylam's doing a great job. Speaking of which, today is Bylam's arrival day. Want to go see him? He'll be arriving soon. There's still some time left until Luce finishes the work she was asked to do by Murakan."
"Sounds good."

The two rode on Shuri and headed out to the sea beyond the Sword Emperor Territory. As soon as they left the Sword Emperor Territory, they had to surround themselves with a protective shield because of the heavy spirit energy, but the beach was completely blue after purification.
The knights waiting on the beach to receive the steel saluted, and Bylam, who had just arrived, bounced in the shallow water to greet them.
[Peep! Hello!]
"Hello, Bylam."
"It's been a while. How's the Blacksmith's Island?"
[Everyone, is, doing well. We, work, happily, every day.]
"Ah, you brought something other than Haegang today?"
Valeria spoke, looking at the steel Bylam spat out. Jin could only gasp at the amount of that special steel.
It was because it was Ancient Eternal Iron.
[It's, better, steel, than, Haegang.]
"It's not just good, it's Ancient Eternal Iron. Did the blacksmiths send it without an order?"
[When, making, golem, it's, good.]
The Ancient Eternal Iron that Bylam brought was sent by the blacksmiths as soon as they heard about the construction of Iello.
As far as Jin knew, the blacksmiths of the Minche Association were not the type to use Ancient Eternal Iron for making anything other than weapons.

Moreover, given the amount of it, they must have given up most of the Ancient Eternal Iron that the Blacksmith's Island had. It was a clear indication of how much they cared about the development of the Federation. Although they couldn't see them as often as Tikan's colleagues, everyone was doing their part.
[Tell, Honka, uncle, to, play, next time. That, uncle, needs, swimming.]
"Okay, I'll tell Honka."
"Say hello to... no, to Picon too."
[Baldy, Yes!]

Bylam waved a "Peep!" and went back to transporting the steel. Jin and Valeria watched his retreating figure with a smile, and they transported the steel to the Sword Emperor Territory along with the knights.
When they came back, Murakan, who had finished his work, was waiting.
"What's this, kiddo. You brutally tear me away from Strawberry Pie, and you go on a date while I work? Uh huh."
Jin felt a bit embarrassed but kept a proud face.

"Don't you see the steel we carried? I've been working too. And who said we brutally tore you apart. It wasn't brutal. Didn't you hear what Gilly said? He said working is much better than reading Chunhwa Collection."
"Che, anyway, you never give in. Where are you going now?"
"I'll drop by the Sword Garden for a moment. I need to check if the magic knight troops are being trained well."
"Is that all you're going to do? I don't want to vomit again. It's not like Strawberry Pie is beating my back like last time."
"I was thinking of visiting the empire too, but seeing you vomit, I guess we can only go as far as the Sword Garden. The other dragons handle teleportation just fine."
"Hmph, that's because they don't have the exquisite senses of this Murakan. Anyway, is it over after we visit the Sword Garden?"

"The teleportation is over. From the evening, you have to attend the welcoming ceremony for the Tikan immigrants on my behalf, and there's a meeting at night, and at dawn you have to spar against the top combatants of Tikan."
"Aaack! When will I get to play with Strawberry Pie!?"
"Well... Let's go."
Valeria chuckled at the bickering duo.
Just as the two were about to board the Red Owl, they saw Luce running towards them. Jin naturally thought he was asking for another autograph like Enya.
So he was about to take out a pen, but Barbovo was materializing above Luce's head.
[Hey, hey! Jin!]
"Lord Barbovo."
"It's been a while for you too, what's the rush?"
[Ah, Murakan. Nice to see you. I heard you were back right away, but I'm only greeting you now.]
"If you don't like me like the old days, don't worry about beating me up and killing me."
[I'm relieved to hear that. Hmm, I apologize for not being able to cooperate with you a thousand years ago.]

A thousand years ago, during the time when the Baekle Autonomy was a kingdom, Runcandel sent knights to contract with Barbovo. At that time, Barbovo went into hiding to avoid getting entangled in the feud of the two major families.
"I understand now, is it something to be sorry about? I'm grateful that you're helping this little guy now."
Barbovo was quite surprised by Murakan's moderate attitude. Those who remembered those days always showed this reaction when they met Murakan.
[I appreciate your understanding. Anyway, the reason I was looking for Jin is... because of Kaitam.]
"Are you talking about the God of Painting?"

When Barbovo contracted with Luche and agreed to assist the alliance, he had requested protection for the gods close to him. It was due to rumors that Zipfel was fuelling a 'god hunt', where gods would become ingredients for the Maseok.
The God of Painting, Kaytam, the God of Frames, Ox, and the God of Pencils, Telpen. Jin had accepted his proposal and had immediately moved the three gods to safe zones they preferred.
-"Among them, the God of Painting has something with you…… It might be best to hear it directly from Kaytam."
Barbovo's words about Kaytam at that time.
However, contrary to what was heard, Kaytam hadn't yet shared anything special with Jin.
[Yes. It seems that Kaytam has developed a desire to talk to you. He wants you to find him as soon as possible.]
The last time Jin saw Kaytam, he seemed to be carrying a heavy burden. He didn't add any more words to Kaytam's troubled look, but it seemed that there was a change in his heart.
'Kaytam seemed to want to tell me something related to Solderet, and it looked very difficult to say. He’s looking for me as soon as Murakan returns...'
Jin somehow felt that the reason was related to Murakan's return.
"No, he can come here himself. Why is he creating a fuss, telling our kid to come and go?"
[Due to the Maseok, we, the lower-middle gods, find it difficult to move freely without protection, Murakan. We can easily be absorbed.]
"Hmm, if that's the case, we can't help it. Right, whether it's a god or whatever, it's right for this Murakan to protect an alliance member."
[You've really changed a lot…… It's really nice to see. Solderet would surely be pleased to see this.]
"Thank you for the compliment."
"I understand, Barbovo. I will visit the God of Painting, Kaytam, right after stopping by the Garden of Swords."
Soon, Jin and Murakan headed to the Garden of Swords on the Red Owl. The knights in the Garden of Swords, having received word of Jin and Murakan's arrival, had already lined up and were waiting.
Many knights hadn't seen Murakan, who had regained his strength, since his return.
Therefore, the knights were inflated with anticipation. They were looking forward to how impressive the legendary black dragon of the family, which was nearing its heyday, would be.
"Ugh. Yuck."
However, the first thing the saluting knights faced was Murakan, whose face had turned pale and was bending over.
'Ah, I told him to just handle it in the carriage….'
Jin could only hold his forehead and shake his head.
